scenarios.situation: You sent a text to a friend 2 hours ago and haven't received a response yet.
scenarios.thought: They must be mad at me. They're probably ignoring me on purpose.
scenarios.explanation: You're assuming you know what someone else is thinking without evidence.
scenarios.reframe: There could be many reasons they haven't responded yet. They might be busy, or their phone could be off. I'll wait before jumping to conclusions.

scenarios.situation: You made a small mistake during a presentation at work.
scenarios.thought: I completely ruined the presentation. Everyone thinks I'm incompetent. I'll probably get fired.
scenarios.explanation: You're imagining the worst possible outcome and treating it as if it's inevitable.
scenarios.reframe: I made one small mistake in an otherwise solid presentation. Everyone makes mistakes, and this doesn't define my overall competence.

scenarios.situation: You didn't get invited to a social gathering.
scenarios.thought: Nobody likes me. I'm always left out.
scenarios.explanation: You're making a broad conclusion based on a single event.
scenarios.reframe: I wasn't invited to this one event. That doesn't mean I'm always left out or that nobody likes me. There could be many reasons I wasn't invited this time.

scenarios.situation: You received constructive criticism on a project.
scenarios.thought: They hated my work. I'm terrible at this.
scenarios.explanation: You're seeing things in black-and-white categories with no middle ground.
scenarios.reframe: There were some areas for improvement, but also things that went well. Constructive feedback helps me grow and doesn't mean my work was all bad.

scenarios.situation: You're feeling anxious about an upcoming exam.
scenarios.thought: I feel anxious, so I must not be prepared. I'm going to fail.
scenarios.explanation: You're assuming that your emotions reflect reality.
scenarios.reframe: Feeling anxious doesn't mean I'm unprepared. Anxiety is normal before exams. I've studied and done the work.

mind_reading.name: Mind Reading
mind_reading.description: Assuming you know what others are thinking without sufficient evidence

catastrophizing.name: Catastrophizing
catastrophizing.description: Imagining and believing the worst possible outcome will occur

overgeneralization.name: Overgeneralization
overgeneralization.description: Drawing broad conclusions from a single event or piece of evidence

all_or_nothing.name: All-or-Nothing Thinking
all_or_nothing.description: Seeing things in black-and-white categories with no middle ground

emotional_reasoning.name: Emotional Reasoning
emotional_reasoning.description: Assuming that negative emotions reflect reality

should_statements.name: Should Statements
should_statements.description: Criticizing yourself or others with 'should' or 'must' statements

labeling.name: Labeling
labeling.description: Assigning global negative traits to yourself or others

personalization.name: Personalization
personalization.description: Blaming yourself for things outside your control
